visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl with black hair tied in two pigtails is hugging the leg of an adult. She wears a beige and white striped long-sleeved shirt and light-colored pants. The adult wears black pants and has a jade bracelet on their wrist. They are in a room with light-colored wooden flooring and a white wall. (2) The adult hands the toddler a massage hammer with a round, spiked head and a wooden handle. The girl takes it with both hands, looking curious. (3) The girl begins walking across the wooden floor, holding the hammer upright. She smiles at the camera. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from an unseen indoor source. (4) The girl stands next to the adult and uses the hammer to gently tap the adult's thigh and hip. She looks focused on the task, her small hands gripping the handle tightly. (5) The girl runs down a hallway with white walls and wooden floors, laughing as she goes. She enters a living area with a low wooden table and a green chair in the background. (6) She approaches another adult sitting on the floor (seen from a low angle perspective) and begins tapping their leg with the hammer. She looks up with a mischievous expression. (7) Finally, she walks to a wooden TV stand/cabinet, places the hammer down, and leans her upper body onto a piece of bubble wrap on the floor, exhaling with a tired expression. (8) A pink graphic screen appears with a cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
